rules: No audit lead is promoted automatically.
Ordinary logic and source-status, motivational, prescriptive, or evaluative modality do not become G1 primitive-demand occurrences.
Mathematical operations, relations, equations, actions, decompositions, representations, and load-bearing side conditions are conserved source-locally.
No textbook semantics, conventional mathematical category assignment, primitive proposal, or W/L correspondence is introduced.
Additional omissions found during source-local adjudication are recorded separately rather than attributed to the cold auditor.
